Worked example (an excursion with an atom). Let $X\sim\mathcal U(-1,1)$ be the signed distance of the state beyond a constraint boundary (positive means violated) and $Z=\max(X,0)=X^+$ the excursion. Then $\mathbb P(Z=0)=\mathbb P(X\le0)=\tfrac12$: an atom at zero. For $0\le z\le1$, $F_Z(z)=\mathbb P(X\le z)=(1+z)/2$, so $F_Z$ jumps from $0$ to $\tfrac12$ at $z=0$ and then rises linearly to $1$ (figure). A nondegenerate Gaussian has no atoms and assigns positive probability to negative values; a degenerate Gaussian is a single point mass. Neither represents this mixed law.

Definition — Expectation, indicator, linearity
$\mathbb E[g(X)]=\sum_xg(x)p(x)$ (discrete) or $\int g(x)p(x)\,dx$ (density), defined when the same sum or integral of $|g|$ is finite ($g(X)$ is then integrable). Linearity: $\mathbb E[aX+bY+c]=a\,\mathbb E[X]+b\,\mathbb E[Y]+c$ for integrable random variables, dependent or not. The indicator $\mathbf 1_A$ of an event is $1$ if $A$ occurs and $0$ otherwise, so $\mathbb E[\mathbf 1_A]=\mathbb P(A)$: probabilities are expectations. The Heaviside step $H(v)=\mathbf 1\{v\gt0\}$ is the indicator of a positive argument (its value at $v=0$ is a convention), and $\mathbf 1\{f(z)\ge0\}$ is the safety indicator of a query $z$.
Subscripts name what is averaged: $\mathbb E_{x\sim\mu}[G(x)]$ averages $G$ over initial states drawn from $\mu$; $\mathbb E_{\tau\sim\pi}$ averages over trajectories generated jointly by the initial law, the policy $\pi$ and the transition law.

Worked example. For the excursion above, $\mathbb E[Z]=0\cdot\tfrac12+\int_0^1z\cdot\tfrac12\,dz=\tfrac14$: the atom contributes nothing, the density $\tfrac12$ on $(0,1]$ the rest. Counting violations: with $c_t=\mathbf 1\{x_t\gt1\}$ and $N=\sum_{t=1}^Tc_t$, linearity gives $\mathbb E[N]=\sum_t\mathbb P(x_t\gt1)$ even though the states of one episode are dependent. If each of $T=50$ steps violates with probability $0.004$, then $\mathbb E[N]=0.2$. Since $N$ is a nonnegative integer, $\mathbf 1\{N\ge1\}\le N$, hence $\mathbb P(\text{at least one violation})\le\mathbb E[N]=0.2$ whatever the dependence. A Boolean test becomes a signed monitor by subtracting one half: $\mathbf 1\{\text{test passed}\}-\tfrac12\in\{-\tfrac12,+\tfrac12\}$ is positive exactly when the test passes.

Definition — Variance, covariance, covariance matrix
Assume finite second moments for the variance and covariance formulas below. $\operatorname{Var}(X)=\mathbb E[(X-\mathbb EX)^2]=\mathbb E[X^2]-(\mathbb EX)^2$; the standard deviation $\sqrt{\operatorname{Var}X}$ has the units of $X$ (noise variance $0.01$ means standard deviation $0.1$), and $\operatorname{Var}(aX+b)=a^2\operatorname{Var}X$. $\operatorname{Cov}(X,Y)=\mathbb E[(X-\mathbb EX)(Y-\mathbb EY)]$. For a random vector $X\in\mathbb R^n$ with mean $m$,
$$\Sigma=\operatorname{Cov}(X)=\mathbb E\big[(X-m)(X-m)^\top\big],\qquad \Sigma_{ij}=\operatorname{Cov}(X_i,X_j),\qquad \operatorname{Cov}(AX+b)=A\Sigma A^\top .$$
Isotropic noise has $\Sigma=\sigma^2I$: uncorrelated coordinates with the same variance $\sigma^2$ in every direction. The correlation of $X,Y$ with standard deviations $\sigma_X,\sigma_Y\gt0$ is $\rho=\operatorname{Cov}(X,Y)/(\sigma_X\sigma_Y)$, the covariance of the standardised variables. It lies in $[-1,1]$ because $0\le\operatorname{Var}\big(\tfrac X{\sigma_X}\pm\tfrac Y{\sigma_Y}\big)=2(1\pm\rho)$, and $\rho=\pm1$ exactly when $Y$ is almost surely an affine function of $X$ (slope of sign $\pm$). In these terms the vector $(X,Y)$ has covariance matrix $\begin{bmatrix}\sigma_X^2&\rho\sigma_X\sigma_Y\\\rho\sigma_X\sigma_Y&\sigma_Y^2\end{bmatrix}$.

Definition — Conditional expectation and the tower rule
$\mathbb E[X\mid Y=y]=\sum_xx\,p(x\mid y)$ (or $\int x\,p(x\mid y)\,dx$) is a number for each $y$; inserting the random $Y$ gives the random variable $\mathbb E[X\mid Y]$, the predictor of $X$ from $Y$ that minimises mean squared error when $\mathbb E[X^2]\lt\infty$. For an event with $\mathbb P(A)\gt0$, $\mathbb E[X\mid A]=\mathbb E[X\mathbf 1_A]/\mathbb P(A)$, i.e. $\mathbb E[X\mathbf 1_A]=\mathbb P(A)\,\mathbb E[X\mid A]$. Two rules do most of the work:
$$\underbrace{\mathbb E\big[\mathbb E[X\mid Y]\big]=\mathbb E[X]}_{\text{tower rule}},\qquad \underbrace{\mathbb E[g(Y)\,X\mid Y]=g(Y)\,\mathbb E[X\mid Y]}_{\text{take out what is known}} .$$
Proof of the tower rule (discrete): $\sum_yp(y)\sum_xx\,p(x\mid y)=\sum_{x,y}x\,p(x,y)=\mathbb E[X]$. $\square$

Worked example (averaging over a policy). In a state $s$, action $a_1$ has expected cost $\mathbb E[X\mid a_1]=2$ and action $a_2$ has $\mathbb E[X\mid a_2]=10$. Under $\pi=(0.7,0.3)$ the tower rule gives $\mathbb E[X]=0.7\cdot2+0.3\cdot10=4.4$. Under another policy $\pi'=(0.9,0.1)$ the conditional expectations, a property of the environment, are unchanged and only the weights move: $0.9\cdot2+0.1\cdot10=2.8$. The performance-difference lemma averages the advantage of $\pi$ over the actions of $\pi'$ in exactly this way.

namespace SafeLearning.CompleteAppliedTotalVarianceMaterial24

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Filter
open scoped ENNReal Matrix.Norms.Elementwise

variable {Ω : Type*} {m₀ : MeasurableSpace Ω} (μ : Measure[m₀] Ω)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (m : MeasurableSpace Ω)

/-- The actual conditional expectation of the centered product, rather than an
assumed covariance decomposition. -/
def conditionalCovariance (X Y : Ω → ℝ) : Ω → ℝ :=
  μ[(X - μ[X | m]) * (Y - μ[Y | m]) | m]

theorem actual_conditional_mean_and_second_moment_tower
    (hm : m ≤ m₀) (X : Ω → ℝ) :
    (∫ ω, (μ[X | m]) ω ∂μ) = ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ ∧
    (∫ ω, (μ[X ^ 2 | m]) ω ∂μ) = ∫ ω, (X ω) ^ 2 ∂μ := by
  exact ⟨integral_condExp hm, integral_condExp hm⟩

theorem actual_conditional_second_moment_is_variance_plus_squared_mean
    (hm : m ≤ m₀) (X : Ω → ℝ) (hX : MemLp X 2 μ) :
    μ[X ^ 2 | m] =ᵐ[μ] fun ω =>
      (condVar m X μ) ω + ((μ[X | m]) ω) ^ 2 := by
  filter_upwards [condVar_ae_eq_condExp_sq_sub_sq_condExp hm hX] with ω h
  dsimp at h ⊢
  linarith

theorem actual_scalar_law_of_total_variance
    (hm : m ≤ m₀) (X : Ω → ℝ) (hX : MemLp X 2 μ) :
    variance X μ = (∫ ω, (condVar m X μ) ω ∂μ) +
      variance (μ[X | m]) μ := by
  exact (integral_condVar_add_variance_condExp hm hX).symm

theorem actual_conditional_covariance_is_conditional_product_minus_mean_product
    (hm : m ≤ m₀) (X Y : Ω → ℝ)
    (hX : MemLp X 2 μ) (hY : MemLp Y 2 μ) :
    conditionalCovariance μ m X Y =ᵐ[μ]
      μ[X * Y | m] - μ[X | m] * μ[Y | m] := by
  have hxm : MemLp (μ[X | m]) 2 μ := hX.condExp one_le_two
  have hym : MemLp (μ[Y | m]) 2 μ := hY.condExp one_le_two
  have hiXY : Integrable (X * Y) μ := memLp_one_iff_integrable.mp (hX.mul hY)
  have hiXym : Integrable (X * μ[Y | m]) μ := memLp_one_iff_integrable.mp (hX.mul hym)
  have hiXmY : Integrable (μ[X | m] * Y) μ := memLp_one_iff_integrable.mp (hxm.mul hY)
  have hiXmYm : Integrable (μ[X | m] * μ[Y | m]) μ :=
    memLp_one_iff_integrable.mp (hxm.mul hym)
  have hexpand :
      (X - μ[X | m]) * (Y - μ[Y | m]) =
        X * Y - X * μ[Y | m] - μ[X | m] * Y + μ[X | m] * μ[Y | m] := by
    ext ω
    simp only [Pi.mul_apply, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.add_apply]
    ring
  rw [conditionalCovariance, hexpand]
  filter_upwards [condExp_add (m := m) ((hiXY.sub hiXym).sub hiXmY) hiXmYm,
    condExp_sub (m := m) (hiXY.sub hiXym) hiXmY,
    condExp_sub (m := m) hiXY hiXym,
    condExp_mul_of_stronglyMeasurable_right
      (stronglyMeasurable_condExp (m := m) (f := Y)) hiXym (hX.integrable one_le_two),
    condExp_mul_of_stronglyMeasurable_left
      (stronglyMeasurable_condExp (m := m) (f := X)) hiXmY (hY.integrable one_le_two)]
    with ω hadd hsub hsub' hright hleft
  rw [condExp_of_stronglyMeasurable hm
    ((stronglyMeasurable_condExp (m := m) (f := X)).mul
      (stronglyMeasurable_condExp (m := m) (f := Y))) hiXmYm] at hadd
  simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.mul_apply] at hadd hsub hsub' hright hleft ⊢
  rw [hadd, hsub, hsub', hright, hleft]
  ring

theorem actual_scalar_law_of_total_covariance
    (hm : m ≤ m₀) (X Y : Ω → ℝ)
    (hX : MemLp X 2 μ) (hY : MemLp Y 2 μ) :
    covariance X Y μ =
      (∫ ω, conditionalCovariance μ m X Y ω ∂μ) +
      covariance (μ[X | m]) (μ[Y | m]) μ := by
  have hprod : Integrable (μ[X | m] * μ[Y | m]) μ :=
    memLp_one_iff_integrable.mp ((hX.condExp one_le_two).mul (hY.condExp one_le_two))
  have hce := actual_conditional_covariance_is_conditional_product_minus_mean_product
    μ m hm X Y hX hY
  rw [integral_congr_ae hce, integral_sub' integrable_condExp hprod,
    integral_condExp hm, covariance_eq_sub hX hY,
    covariance_eq_sub (hX.condExp one_le_two) (hY.condExp one_le_two),
    integral_condExp hm, integral_condExp hm]
  ring

def covarianceMatrix {ι : Type*} (X : ι → Ω → ℝ) : Matrix ι ι ℝ :=
  fun i j => covariance (X i) (X j) μ

def conditionalCovarianceMatrix {ι : Type*} (X : ι → Ω → ℝ) : Ω → Matrix ι ι ℝ :=
  fun ω i j => conditionalCovariance μ m (X i) (X j) ω

/-- The expectation here is a genuine matrix-valued Bochner integral. -/
theorem actual_finite_vector_law_of_total_covariance
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (hm : m ≤ m₀)
    (X : ι → Ω → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 2 μ) :
    covarianceMatrix μ X =
      (∫ ω, conditionalCovarianceMatrix μ m X ω ∂μ) +
      covarianceMatrix μ (fun i => μ[X i | m]) := by
  have hi (i j : ι) : Integrable (fun ω => conditionalCovariance μ m (X i) (X j) ω) μ :=
    integrable_condExp
  have hir (i : ι) : Integrable (fun ω j => conditionalCovariance μ m (X i) (X j) ω) μ :=
    Integrable.of_eval (hi i)
  ext i j
  change covariance (X i) (X j) μ =
    (∫ ω, conditionalCovarianceMatrix μ m X ω ∂μ) i j +
      covariance (μ[X i | m]) (μ[X j | m]) μ
  have heval : (∫ ω, conditionalCovarianceMatrix μ m X ω ∂μ) i j =
      ∫ ω, conditionalCovariance μ m (X i) (X j) ω ∂μ := by
    change (∫ ω, fun i j => conditionalCovariance μ m (X i) (X j) ω ∂μ) i j = _
    rw [eval_integral hir i, eval_integral (hi i) j]
  rw [heval]
  exact actual_scalar_law_of_total_covariance μ m hm (X i) (X j) (hX i) (hX j)

theorem actual_scalar_law_conditioning_on_a_measurable_random_variable
    {Υ : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Υ] (Y : Ω → Υ) (hY : @Measurable Ω Υ m₀ ‹MeasurableSpace Υ› Y)
    (X : Ω → ℝ) (hX : MemLp X 2 μ) :
    variance X μ =
      (∫ ω, condVar (MeasurableSpace.comap Y ‹MeasurableSpace Υ›) X μ ω ∂μ) +
      variance (μ[X | MeasurableSpace.comap Y ‹MeasurableSpace Υ›]) μ := by
  exact actual_scalar_law_of_total_variance μ _ hY.comap_le X hX

end SafeLearning.CompleteAppliedTotalVarianceMaterial24

/-- Conditional variance of a real-valued random variable. It is defined as `0` if any one of the
following conditions is true:
- `m` is not a sub-σ-algebra of `m₀`,
- `μ` is not σ-finite with respect to `m`,
- `X - μ[X | m]` is not square-integrable. -/
noncomputable def condVar : Ω → ℝ := μ[(X - μ[X | m]) ^ 2 | m]

@[inherit_doc] scoped notation "Var[" X "; " μ " | " m "]" => condVar m X μ

/-- Conditional variance of a real-valued random variable. It is defined as `0` if any one of the
following conditions is true:
- `m` is not a sub-σ-algebra of `m₀`,
- `volume` is not σ-finite with respect to `m`,
- `X - 𝔼[X | m]` is not square-integrable. -/
scoped notation "Var[" f "|" m "]" => Var[f; MeasureTheory.volume | m]

lemma condVar_of_not_le (hm : ¬m ≤ m₀) : Var[X; μ | m] = 0 := by rw [condVar, condExp_of_not_le hm]

lemma condVar_of_not_sigmaFinite (hμm : ¬SigmaFinite (μ.trim hm)) :
    Var[X; μ | m] = 0 := by rw [condVar, condExp_of_not_sigmaFinite hm hμm]

open scoped Classical in
lemma condVar_of_sigmaFinite [SigmaFinite (μ.trim hm)] :
    Var[X; μ | m] =
      if Integrable (fun ω ↦ (X ω - (μ[X | m]) ω) ^ 2) μ then
        if StronglyMeasurable[m] (fun ω ↦ (X ω - (μ[X | m]) ω) ^ 2) then
          fun ω ↦ (X ω - (μ[X | m]) ω) ^ 2
        else aestronglyMeasurable_condExpL1.mk (condExpL1 hm μ fun ω ↦ (X ω - (μ[X | m]) ω) ^ 2)
      else 0 := condExp_of_sigmaFinite _

lemma condVar_of_stronglyMeasurable [SigmaFinite (μ.trim hm)]
    (hX : StronglyMeasurable[m] X) (hXint : Integrable ((X - μ[X | m]) ^ 2) μ) :
    Var[X; μ | m] = fun ω ↦ (X ω - (μ[X | m]) ω) ^ 2 :=
  condExp_of_stronglyMeasurable _ ((hX.sub stronglyMeasurable_condExp).pow _) hXint

lemma condVar_of_not_integrable (hXint : ¬ Integrable (fun ω ↦ (X ω - (μ[X | m]) ω) ^ 2) μ) :
    Var[X; μ | m] = 0 := condExp_of_not_integrable hXint

@[simp] lemma condVar_zero : Var[0; μ | m] = 0 := by simp [condVar]

@[simp]
lemma condVar_const (hm : m ≤ m₀) (c : ℝ) : Var[fun _ ↦ c; μ | m] = 0 := by
  obtain rfl | hc := eq_or_ne c 0
  · simp [← Pi.zero_def]
  by_cases hμm : IsFiniteMeasure μ
  · simp [condVar, hm]
  · simp [condVar, condExp_of_not_integrable, integrable_const_iff_isFiniteMeasure hc,
      integrable_const_iff_isFiniteMeasure <| pow_ne_zero _ hc, hμm, Pi.pow_def]

lemma stronglyMeasurable_condVar : StronglyMeasurable[m] (Var[X; μ | m]) :=
  stronglyMeasurable_condExp

lemma condVar_congr_ae (h : X =ᵐ[μ] Y) : Var[X; μ | m] =ᵐ[μ] Var[Y; μ | m] :=
  condExp_congr_ae <| by filter_upwards [h, condExp_congr_ae h] with ω hω hω'; dsimp; rw [hω, hω']

lemma condVar_of_aestronglyMeasurable [hμm : SigmaFinite (μ.trim hm)]
    (hX : AEStronglyMeasurable[m] X μ) (hXint : Integrable ((X - μ[X | m]) ^ 2) μ) :
    Var[X; μ | m] =ᵐ[μ] (X - μ[X | m]) ^ 2 :=
  condExp_of_aestronglyMeasurable' _ ((continuous_pow _).comp_aestronglyMeasurable
    (hX.sub stronglyMeasurable_condExp.aestronglyMeasurable)) hXint

lemma integrable_condVar : Integrable Var[X; μ | m] μ := integrable_condExp

/-- The integral of the conditional variance `Var[X | m]` over an `m`-measurable set is equal to
the integral of `(X - μ[X | m]) ^ 2` on that set. -/
lemma setIntegral_condVar [SigmaFinite (μ.trim hm)] (hX : Integrable ((X - μ[X | m]) ^ 2) μ)
    (hs : MeasurableSet[m] s) :
    ∫ ω in s, (Var[X; μ | m]) ω ∂μ = ∫ ω in s, (X ω - (μ[X | m]) ω) ^ 2 ∂μ :=
  setIntegral_condExp _ hX hs

-- `condVar_ae_eq_condExp_sq_sub_condExp_sq` is a bit ridiculous, so we exceptionally denote it by

lemma condVar_ae_eq_condExp_sq_sub_sq_condExp (hm : m ≤ m₀) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (hX : MemLp X 2 μ) :
    Var[X; μ | m] =ᵐ[μ] μ[X ^ 2 | m] - μ[X | m] ^ 2 := by
  calc
    Var[X; μ | m]
    _ = μ[X ^ 2 - 2 * X * μ[X | m] + μ[X | m] ^ 2 | m] := by rw [condVar, sub_sq]
    _ =ᵐ[μ] μ[X ^ 2 | m] - 2 * μ[X | m] ^ 2 + μ[X | m] ^ 2 := by
      have aux₀ : Integrable (X ^ 2) μ := hX.integrable_sq
      have aux₁ : Integrable (2 * X * μ[X | m]) μ := by
        rw [mul_assoc]
        exact (memLp_one_iff_integrable.1 <| hX.mul (hX.condExp one_le_two)).const_mul _
      have aux₂ : Integrable (μ[X | m] ^ 2) μ := (hX.condExp one_le_two).integrable_sq
      filter_upwards [condExp_add (m := m) (aux₀.sub aux₁) aux₂, condExp_sub (m := m) aux₀ aux₁,
        condExp_mul_of_stronglyMeasurable_right stronglyMeasurable_condExp aux₁
          ((hX.integrable one_le_two).const_mul _), condExp_ofNat (m := m) 2 X]
        with ω hω₀ hω₁ hω₂ hω₃
      simp [hω₀, hω₁, hω₂, hω₃,
        condExp_of_stronglyMeasurable hm (stronglyMeasurable_condExp.pow _) aux₂]
      simp [mul_assoc, sq]
    _ = μ[X ^ 2 | m] - μ[X | m] ^ 2 := by ring

    Var[X; μ | m] ≤ᵐ[μ] μ[X ^ 2 | m] := by
  filter_upwards [condVar_ae_eq_condExp_sq_sub_sq_condExp hm hX] with ω hω
  dsimp at hω
  nlinarith

/-- **Law of total variance** -/
lemma integral_condVar_add_variance_condExp (hm : m ≤ m₀) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hX : MemLp X 2 μ) : μ[Var[X; μ | m]] + Var[μ[X | m]; μ] = Var[X; μ] := by
  calc
    μ[Var[X; μ | m]] + Var[μ[X | m]; μ]
    _ = μ[(μ[X ^ 2 | m] - μ[X | m] ^ 2 : Ω → ℝ)] + (μ[μ[X | m] ^ 2] - μ[μ[X | m]] ^ 2) := by
      congr 1
      · exact integral_congr_ae <| condVar_ae_eq_condExp_sq_sub_sq_condExp hm hX

    _ = μ[X ^ 2] - μ[μ[X | m] ^ 2] + (μ[μ[X | m] ^ 2] - μ[X] ^ 2) := by
      rw [integral_sub' integrable_condExp, integral_condExp hm, integral_condExp hm]
      exact (hX.condExp one_le_two).integrable_sq

$\mathbb E[g(X)]=\sum_xg(x)p(x)$ (discrete) or $\int g(x)p(x)\,dx$ (density), defined when the same sum or integral of $|g|$ is finite ($g(X)$ is then integrable). Linearity: $\mathbb E[aX+bY+c]=a\,\mathbb E[X]+b\,\mathbb E[Y]+c$ for integrable random variables, dependent or not. The indicator $\mathbf 1_A$ of an event is $1$ if $A$ occurs and $0$ otherwise, so $\mathbb E[\mathbf 1_A]=\mathbb P(A)$: probabilities are expectations. The Heaviside step $H(v)=\mathbf 1\{v\gt0\}$ is the indicator of a positive argument (its value at $v=0$ is a convention), and $\mathbf 1\{f(z)\ge0\}$ is the safety indicator of a query $z$.
Subscripts name what is averaged: $\mathbb E_{x\sim\mu}[G(x)]$ averages $G$ over initial states drawn from $\mu$; $\mathbb E_{\tau\sim\pi}$ averages over trajectories generated jointly by the initial law, the policy $\pi$ and the transition law.

Worked example. For the excursion above, $\mathbb E[Z]=0\cdot\tfrac12+\int_0^1z\cdot\tfrac12\,dz=\tfrac14$: the atom contributes nothing, the density $\tfrac12$ on $(0,1]$ the rest. Counting violations: with $c_t=\mathbf 1\{x_t\gt1\}$ and $N=\sum_{t=1}^Tc_t$, linearity gives $\mathbb E[N]=\sum_t\mathbb P(x_t\gt1)$ even though the states of one episode are dependent. If each of $T=50$ steps violates with probability $0.004$, then $\mathbb E[N]=0.2$. Since $N$ is a nonnegative integer, $\mathbf 1\{N\ge1\}\le N$, hence $\mathbb P(\text{at least one violation})\le\mathbb E[N]=0.2$ whatever the dependence. A Boolean test becomes a signed monitor by subtracting one half: $\mathbf 1\{\text{test passed}\}-\tfrac12\in\{-\tfrac12,+\tfrac12\}$ is positive exactly when the test passes.

Definition — Variance, covariance, covariance matrix
Assume finite second moments for the variance and covariance formulas below. $\operatorname{Var}(X)=\mathbb E[(X-\mathbb EX)^2]=\mathbb E[X^2]-(\mathbb EX)^2$; the standard deviation $\sqrt{\operatorname{Var}X}$ has the units of $X$ (noise variance $0.01$ means standard deviation $0.1$), and $\operatorname{Var}(aX+b)=a^2\operatorname{Var}X$. $\operatorname{Cov}(X,Y)=\mathbb E[(X-\mathbb EX)(Y-\mathbb EY)]$. For a random vector $X\in\mathbb R^n$ with mean $m$,
$$\Sigma=\operatorname{Cov}(X)=\mathbb E\big[(X-m)(X-m)^\top\big],\qquad \Sigma_{ij}=\operatorname{Cov}(X_i,X_j),\qquad \operatorname{Cov}(AX+b)=A\Sigma A^\top .$$
Isotropic noise has $\Sigma=\sigma^2I$: uncorrelated coordinates with the same variance $\sigma^2$ in every direction. The correlation of $X,Y$ with standard deviations $\sigma_X,\sigma_Y\gt0$ is $\rho=\operatorname{Cov}(X,Y)/(\sigma_X\sigma_Y)$, the covariance of the standardised variables. It lies in $[-1,1]$ because $0\le\operatorname{Var}\big(\tfrac X{\sigma_X}\pm\tfrac Y{\sigma_Y}\big)=2(1\pm\rho)$, and $\rho=\pm1$ exactly when $Y$ is almost surely an affine function of $X$ (slope of sign $\pm$). In these terms the vector $(X,Y)$ has covariance matrix $\begin{bmatrix}\sigma_X^2&\rho\sigma_X\sigma_Y\\\rho\sigma_X\sigma_Y&\sigma_Y^2\end{bmatrix}$.

$$\mathbb P(s_0,a_0,s_1,a_1,s_2)=\mu(s_0)\,\pi(a_0\mid s_0)\,P(s_1\mid s_0,a_0)\,\pi(a_1\mid s_1)\,P(s_2\mid s_1,a_1),$$

and total probability gives marginals, $\mathbb P(s_1=s')=\sum_{s,a}\mu(s)\,\pi(a\mid s)\,P(s'\mid s,a)$. For instance, from $\mu=\delta_{s_0}$ with two actions of probability $0.5$ each that reach an unsafe state with probabilities $0.2$ and $0.6$, $\mathbb P(s_1\text{ unsafe})=0.5\cdot0.2+0.5\cdot0.6=0.4$. Decorations such as $\mathbb P^\pi_\mu$ or $\mathbb E_{\tau\sim\pi}$ record which $\mu$, $\pi$ and $P$ generate the trajectory; change any of them and every probability changes.

Definition — Conditional expectation and the tower rule
$\mathbb E[X\mid Y=y]=\sum_xx\,p(x\mid y)$ (or $\int x\,p(x\mid y)\,dx$) is a number for each $y$; inserting the random $Y$ gives the random variable $\mathbb E[X\mid Y]$, the predictor of $X$ from $Y$ that minimises mean squared error when $\mathbb E[X^2]\lt\infty$. For an event with $\mathbb P(A)\gt0$, $\mathbb E[X\mid A]=\mathbb E[X\mathbf 1_A]/\mathbb P(A)$, i.e. $\mathbb E[X\mathbf 1_A]=\mathbb P(A)\,\mathbb E[X\mid A]$. Two rules do most of the work:
$$\underbrace{\mathbb E\big[\mathbb E[X\mid Y]\big]=\mathbb E[X]}_{\text{tower rule}},\qquad \underbrace{\mathbb E[g(Y)\,X\mid Y]=g(Y)\,\mathbb E[X\mid Y]}_{\text{take out what is known}} .$$
Proof of the tower rule (discrete): $\sum_yp(y)\sum_xx\,p(x\mid y)=\sum_{x,y}x\,p(x,y)=\mathbb E[X]$. $\square$

Worked example (averaging over a policy). In a state $s$, action $a_1$ has expected cost $\mathbb E[X\mid a_1]=2$ and action $a_2$ has $\mathbb E[X\mid a_2]=10$. Under $\pi=(0.7,0.3)$ the tower rule gives $\mathbb E[X]=0.7\cdot2+0.3\cdot10=4.4$. Under another policy $\pi'=(0.9,0.1)$ the conditional expectations, a property of the environment, are unchanged and only the weights move: $0.9\cdot2+0.1\cdot10=2.8$. The performance-difference lemma averages the advantage of $\pi$ over the actions of $\pi'$ in exactly this way.

Theorem — Law of total variance
$\operatorname{Var}(X)=\mathbb E\big[\operatorname{Var}(X\mid Y)\big]+\operatorname{Var}\big(\mathbb E[X\mid Y]\big)$: the average spread within groups plus the spread of the group means. Proof. With $\bar X=\mathbb E[X\mid Y]$, the tower rule gives $\mathbb E[X^2]=\mathbb E\big[\mathbb E[X^2\mid Y]\big]=\mathbb E\big[\operatorname{Var}(X\mid Y)+\bar X^2\big]$ and $\mathbb E[X]=\mathbb E[\bar X]$; subtract $(\mathbb E\bar X)^2$ from both sides. $\square$ For vectors, $\operatorname{Cov}(X)=\mathbb E[\operatorname{Cov}(X\mid Y)]+\operatorname{Cov}(\mathbb E[X\mid Y])$.
Definition — Mixture distribution
First draw a label $L$ with $\mathbb P(L=j)=w_j$, then draw $X$ from the component law $p_j$ (mean $m_j$, variance $\sigma_j^2$). Then $X$ has density $p(x)=\sum_jw_jp_j(x)$, mean $\bar m=\sum_jw_jm_j$ and, by total variance, $\operatorname{Var}X=\sum_jw_j\sigma_j^2+\sum_jw_j(m_j-\bar m)^2$.

Worked example (small and large errors). Residuals that are $\mathcal N(0,0.5^2)$ with probability $0.8$ and $\mathcal N(0,3^2)$ with probability $0.2$ (the "80% small, 20% large" option of the Module 15 explorer) have variance $0.8\cdot0.25+0.2\cdot9=2$. Their tail is nothing like that of $\mathcal N(0,2)$: $\mathbb P(|E|\gt5)=0.8\cdot\mathbb P(|Z|\gt10)+0.2\cdot\mathbb P(|Z|\gt\tfrac53)\approx0.019$, against $0.0004$ for the Gaussian with the same variance, while near zero the mixture is more concentrated ($\mathbb P(|E|\gt1)\approx0.18$ against $0.48$). An ensemble of $E$ Gaussian predictions is an equal-weight mixture: its covariance is the average member covariance (aleatoric part) plus the covariance of the member means (epistemic part, the $\hat\Sigma$ of Section 1).

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open scoped ENNReal NNReal BigOperators

variable {ι Ω : Type*} [Fintype ι] [MeasurableSpace Ω]

def finiteMixture (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (μ : ι → Measure Ω) : Measure Ω :=
  ∑ i, (w i : ℝ≥0∞) • μ i

theorem actual_finite_mixture_is_a_probability_law
    (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (hw : ∑ i, w i = 1)
    (μ : ι → Measure Ω) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)] :
    IsProbabilityMeasure (finiteMixture w μ) := by
  constructor
  simp only [finiteMixture, Measure.finsetSum_apply, Measure.smul_apply,
    measure_univ, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  exact_mod_cast hw

theorem actual_finite_mixture_integral
    (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (μ : ι → Measure Ω) (X : Ω → ℝ)
    (hX : ∀ i, Integrable X (μ i)) :
    (∫ ω, X ω ∂finiteMixture w μ) =
      ∑ i, (w i : ℝ) * ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ i := by
  rw [finiteMixture, integral_finsetSum_measure
    (fun i _ => (hX i).smul_measure ENNReal.coe_ne_top)]
  simp [NNReal.smul_def, smul_eq_mul]

theorem actual_finite_mixture_has_finite_second_moment
    (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (μ : ι → Measure Ω) (X : Ω → ℝ)
    (hX : ∀ i, MemLp X 2 (μ i)) : MemLp X 2 (finiteMixture w μ) := by
  have hs : AEStronglyMeasurable X (finiteMixture w μ) := by
    rw [finiteMixture, ← Measure.sum_fintype]
    exact AEStronglyMeasurable.sum_measure
      (fun i => ((hX i).smul_measure ENNReal.coe_ne_top).aestronglyMeasurable)
  apply (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq hs).mpr
  rw [finiteMixture, integrable_finsetSum_measure]
  intro i _
  exact ((hX i).smul_measure ENNReal.coe_ne_top).integrable_sq

theorem actual_finite_mixture_mean
    (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (μ : ι → Measure Ω) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)]
    (X : Ω → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp X 2 (μ i)) :
    (∫ ω, X ω ∂finiteMixture w μ) =
      ∑ i, (w i : ℝ) * ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ i :=
  actual_finite_mixture_integral w μ X (fun i => (hX i).integrable one_le_two)

theorem actual_finite_mixture_variance
    (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (hw : ∑ i, w i = 1)
    (μ : ι → Measure Ω) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)]
    (X : Ω → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp X 2 (μ i)) :
    variance X (finiteMixture w μ) =
      (∑ i, (w i : ℝ) * variance X (μ i)) +
      ∑ i, (w i : ℝ) *
        ((∫ ω, X ω ∂μ i) - ∑ j, (w j : ℝ) * ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ j)^2 := by
  haveI := actual_finite_mixture_is_a_probability_law w hw μ
  have hr : ∑ i, (w i : ℝ) = 1 := by exact_mod_cast hw
  let m : ι → ℝ := fun i => ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ i
  let M : ℝ := ∑ i, (w i : ℝ) * m i
  have he : (∑ i, (w i : ℝ) * (m i - M)^2) =
      (∑ i, (w i : ℝ) * (m i)^2) - M^2 := by
    have hexp (i : ι) : (w i : ℝ) * (m i - M)^2 =
        (w i : ℝ) * (m i)^2 - (2*M)*((w i : ℝ)*m i) +
          M^2 * (w i : ℝ) := by ring
    simp_rw [hexp]
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
      ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.mul_sum, hr]
    change (∑ i, (w i : ℝ) * (m i)^2) - (2*M)*M + M^2*1 = _
    ring
  rw [variance_eq_sub (actual_finite_mixture_has_finite_second_moment w μ X hX),
    actual_finite_mixture_mean w μ X hX]
  have hsq := actual_finite_mixture_integral w μ (fun ω => (X ω)^2)
    (fun i => (hX i).integrable_sq)
  simp only [Pi.pow_apply] at hsq ⊢
  rw [hsq]
  have hv (i : ι) : variance X (μ i) = (∫ ω, (X ω)^2 ∂μ i) - (m i)^2 :=
    variance_eq_sub (hX i)
  simp_rw [hv, mul_sub]
  rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  change (∑ i, (w i : ℝ) * ∫ ω, (X ω)^2 ∂μ i) - M^2 =
      ((∑ i, (w i : ℝ) * ∫ ω, (X ω)^2 ∂μ i) -
        ∑ i, (w i : ℝ) * (m i)^2) + ∑ i, (w i : ℝ) * (m i - M)^2
  rw [he]
  ring

theorem actual_finite_mixture_of_densities_has_the_printed_density
    (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (base : Measure Ω) (p : ι → Ω → ℝ≥0∞)
    (hp : ∀ i, Measurable (p i)) :
    finiteMixture w (fun i => base.withDensity (p i)) =
      base.withDensity (fun ω => ∑ i, (w i : ℝ≥0∞) * p i ω) := by
  rw [finiteMixture, ← Measure.sum_fintype]
  have he (i : ι) : (w i : ℝ≥0∞) • base.withDensity (p i) =
      base.withDensity ((w i : ℝ≥0∞) • p i) :=
    (withDensity_smul (w i : ℝ≥0∞) (hp i)).symm
  simp_rw [he]
  change (Measure.sum (fun i => base.withDensity (fun ω => (w i : ℝ≥0∞) * p i ω))) = _
  rw [← withDensity_tsum (μ := base)
    (f := fun i ω => (w i : ℝ≥0∞) * p i ω)
    (fun i => measurable_const.mul (hp i))]
  congr 1
  ext ω
  simp [tsum_fintype, smul_eq_mul]

variable [MeasurableSpace ι] [MeasurableSingletonClass ι]

def twoStageLaw (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (μ : ι → Measure Ω) : Measure (ι × Ω) :=
  finiteMixture w (fun i => (Measure.dirac i).prod (μ i))

omit [MeasurableSingletonClass ι] in
theorem actual_two_stage_joint_is_a_probability_law
    (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (hw : ∑ i, w i = 1)
    (μ : ι → Measure Ω) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)] :
    IsProbabilityMeasure (twoStageLaw w μ) :=
  actual_finite_mixture_is_a_probability_law w hw _

theorem actual_two_stage_label_and_component_rectangle
    (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (μ : ι → Measure Ω) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)]
    (j : ι) (s : Set Ω) (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    twoStageLaw w μ ({j} ×ˢ s) = (w j : ℝ≥0∞) * μ j s := by
  classical
  simp only [twoStageLaw, finiteMixture, Measure.finsetSum_apply, Measure.smul_apply,
    smul_eq_mul, Measure.prod_prod, Measure.dirac_apply, Set.indicator_singleton, Pi.one_apply]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j]
  · simp
  · intro b _ hb
    simp [Pi.single_apply, hb, Ne.symm hb]
  · simp

omit [MeasurableSingletonClass ι] in
theorem actual_two_stage_second_marginal_is_the_finite_mixture
    (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (μ : ι → Measure Ω) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)] :
    (twoStageLaw w μ).snd = finiteMixture w μ := by
  ext s hs
  rw [Measure.snd_apply hs]
  have hpre : Prod.snd ⁻¹' s = (Set.univ : Set ι) ×ˢ s := by
    ext p
    simp
  rw [hpre]
  simp [twoStageLaw, finiteMixture, Measure.finsetSum_apply, Measure.smul_apply,

variable {ι Ω : Type*} [Countable ι] [MeasurableSpace Ω]

def countableMixture (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (μ : ι → Measure Ω) : Measure Ω :=
  Measure.sum (fun i => (w i : ℝ≥0∞) • μ i)

theorem actual_countable_mixture_is_a_probability_law
    (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (hw : ∑' i, (w i : ℝ≥0∞) = 1)
    (μ : ι → Measure Ω) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)] :
    IsProbabilityMeasure (countableMixture w μ) := by
  constructor
  simp only [countableMixture, Measure.sum_apply_of_countable, Measure.smul_apply,
    measure_univ, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  exact hw

theorem actual_countable_mixture_integral_hasSum
    (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (μ : ι → Measure Ω) (X : Ω → ℝ)
    (hX : Integrable X (countableMixture w μ)) :
    HasSum (fun i => (w i : ℝ) * ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ i)
      (∫ ω, X ω ∂countableMixture w μ) := by
  simpa only [countableMixture, integral_smul_measure, ENNReal.coe_toReal,
    smul_eq_mul] using hasSum_integral_measure hX

theorem actual_countable_mixture_mean
    (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (hw : ∑' i, (w i : ℝ≥0∞) = 1)
    (μ : ι → Measure Ω) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)]
    (X : Ω → ℝ) (hX : MemLp X 2 (countableMixture w μ)) :
    (∫ ω, X ω ∂countableMixture w μ) =
      ∑' i, (w i : ℝ) * ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ i := by
  haveI := actual_countable_mixture_is_a_probability_law w hw μ
  exact (actual_countable_mixture_integral_hasSum w μ X
    (hX.integrable one_le_two)).tsum_eq.symm

private theorem component_centered_second_moment
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (X : Ω → ℝ) (hX : MemLp X 2 μ) (M : ℝ) :
    (∫ ω, (X ω - M)^2 ∂μ) = variance X μ + ((∫ ω, X ω ∂μ) - M)^2 := by
  have hx := hX.integrable one_le_two
  have hp : (fun ω => (X ω - M)^2) =
      (fun ω => (X ω)^2 - (2*M)*X ω + M^2) := by ext ω; ring
  rw [hp]
  change (∫ ω, ((fun ω => (X ω)^2) - (fun ω => (2*M)*X ω)) ω + M^2 ∂μ) = _
  rw [integral_add (hX.integrable_sq.sub (hx.const_mul (2*M)))
    (integrable_const _)]
  simp only [Pi.sub_apply]
  rw [integral_sub hX.integrable_sq (hx.const_mul (2*M)),
    integral_const_mul, integral_const, variance_eq_sub hX]
  simp only [measureReal_def, measure_univ, ENNReal.toReal_one, one_smul, Pi.pow_apply]
  ring

theorem actual_countable_mixture_variance_and_series_summability
    (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (hw : ∑' i, (w i : ℝ≥0∞) = 1)
    (μ : ι → Measure Ω) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)]
    (X : Ω → ℝ) (hX : MemLp X 2 (countableMixture w μ))
    (hXi : ∀ i, MemLp X 2 (μ i)) :
    Summable (fun i => (w i : ℝ) * variance X (μ i)) ∧
    Summable (fun i => (w i : ℝ) *
      ((∫ ω, X ω ∂μ i) - ∑' j, (w j : ℝ) * ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ j)^2) ∧
    variance X (countableMixture w μ) =
      (∑' i, (w i : ℝ) * variance X (μ i)) +
      ∑' i, (w i : ℝ) *
        ((∫ ω, X ω ∂μ i) - ∑' j, (w j : ℝ) * ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ j)^2 := by
  haveI := actual_countable_mixture_is_a_probability_law w hw μ
  let M : ℝ := ∫ ω, X ω ∂countableMixture w μ
  let a : ι → ℝ := fun i => (w i : ℝ) * variance X (μ i)
  let b : ι → ℝ := fun i => (w i : ℝ) * ((∫ ω, X ω ∂μ i) - M)^2
  have hs := actual_countable_mixture_integral_hasSum w μ (fun ω => (X ω - M)^2)
    (hX.sub (memLp_const M)).integrable_sq
  have he (i : ι) : (w i : ℝ) * (∫ ω, (X ω - M)^2 ∂μ i) = a i + b i := by
    rw [component_centered_second_moment (μ i) X (hXi i) M]
    simp only [a, b, mul_add]
  simp_rw [he] at hs
  have ha0 (i : ι) : 0 ≤ a i := mul_nonneg (NNReal.coe_nonneg _) (variance_nonneg _ _)
  have hb0 (i : ι) : 0 ≤ b i := mul_nonneg (NNReal.coe_nonneg _) (sq_nonneg _)
  have has : Summable a := Summable.of_nonneg_of_le ha0
    (fun i => le_add_of_nonneg_right (hb0 i)) hs.summable
  have hbs : Summable b := Summable.of_nonneg_of_le hb0
    (fun i => le_add_of_nonneg_left (ha0 i)) hs.summable
  have hm := actual_countable_mixture_mean w hw μ X hX
  have hvar : variance X (countableMixture w μ) = (∑' i, a i) + ∑' i, b i := by
    rw [variance_eq_integral hX.aemeasurable, ← hs.tsum_eq]
    exact has.tsum_add hbs
  simpa only [a, b, M, hm] using And.intro has (And.intro hbs hvar)

theorem actual_countable_mixture_of_densities_has_the_printed_density
    (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (base : Measure Ω) (p : ι → Ω → ℝ≥0∞)
    (hp : ∀ i, Measurable (p i)) :
    countableMixture w (fun i => base.withDensity (p i)) =
      base.withDensity (fun ω => ∑' i, (w i : ℝ≥0∞) * p i ω) := by
  have he (i : ι) : (w i : ℝ≥0∞) • base.withDensity (p i) =
      base.withDensity ((w i : ℝ≥0∞) • p i) :=
    (withDensity_smul (w i : ℝ≥0∞) (hp i)).symm
  simp_rw [countableMixture, he]
  change (Measure.sum (fun i => base.withDensity (fun ω => (w i : ℝ≥0∞) * p i ω))) = _
  rw [← withDensity_tsum (μ := base)
    (f := fun i ω => (w i : ℝ≥0∞) * p i ω)
    (fun i => measurable_const.mul (hp i))]
  congr 1
  ext ω
  exact ENNReal.tsum_apply

variable [MeasurableSpace ι] [MeasurableSingletonClass ι]

def twoStageLaw (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (μ : ι → Measure Ω) : Measure (ι × Ω) :=
  countableMixture w (fun i => (Measure.dirac i).prod (μ i))

theorem actual_two_stage_joint_is_a_probability_law
    (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (hw : ∑' i, (w i : ℝ≥0∞) = 1)
    (μ : ι → Measure Ω) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)] :
    IsProbabilityMeasure (twoStageLaw w μ) :=
  actual_countable_mixture_is_a_probability_law w hw _

theorem actual_two_stage_label_and_component_rectangle
    (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (μ : ι → Measure Ω) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)]
    (j : ι) (s : Set Ω) :
    twoStageLaw w μ ({j} ×ˢ s) = (w j : ℝ≥0∞) * μ j s := by
  classical
  simp only [twoStageLaw, countableMixture, Measure.sum_apply_of_countable,
    Measure.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Measure.prod_prod, Measure.dirac_apply,
    Set.indicator_singleton, Pi.one_apply]
  rw [tsum_eq_single j]
  · simp
  · intro b hb
    simp [Pi.single_apply, hb, Ne.symm hb]

theorem actual_two_stage_label_probability
    (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (μ : ι → Measure Ω) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)]
    (j : ι) : (twoStageLaw w μ).fst {j} = (w j : ℝ≥0∞) := by
  rw [Measure.fst_apply (measurableSet_singleton j)]
  have hpre : Prod.fst ⁻¹' ({j} : Set ι) = {j} ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set Ω) := by
    ext p; simp
  rw [hpre, actual_two_stage_label_and_component_rectangle]
  simp

theorem actual_two_stage_second_marginal_is_the_countable_mixture
    (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (μ : ι → Measure Ω) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)] :
    (twoStageLaw w μ).snd = countableMixture w μ := by
  ext s hs
  rw [Measure.snd_apply hs]
  have hpre : Prod.snd ⁻¹' s = (Set.univ : Set ι) ×ˢ s := by ext p; simp
  rw [hpre]
  simp [twoStageLaw, countableMixture, Measure.sum_apply_of_countable,
    Measure.smul_apply, Measure.prod_prod]

namespace SafeLearning.CompleteAppliedFiniteMixtureMaterial24
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open scoped ENNReal NNReal BigOperators

variable {ι Ω : Type*} [Fintype ι] [MeasurableSpace Ω]

def finiteMixture (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (μ : ι → Measure Ω) : Measure Ω :=
  ∑ i, (w i : ℝ≥0∞) • μ i

theorem actual_finite_mixture_is_a_probability_law
    (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (hw : ∑ i, w i = 1)
    (μ : ι → Measure Ω) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)] :
    IsProbabilityMeasure (finiteMixture w μ) := by
  constructor
  simp only [finiteMixture, Measure.finsetSum_apply, Measure.smul_apply,
    measure_univ, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  exact_mod_cast hw

theorem actual_finite_mixture_integral
    (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (μ : ι → Measure Ω) (X : Ω → ℝ)
    (hX : ∀ i, Integrable X (μ i)) :
    (∫ ω, X ω ∂finiteMixture w μ) =
      ∑ i, (w i : ℝ) * ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ i := by
  rw [finiteMixture, integral_finsetSum_measure
    (fun i _ => (hX i).smul_measure ENNReal.coe_ne_top)]
  simp [NNReal.smul_def, smul_eq_mul]

theorem actual_finite_mixture_has_finite_second_moment
    (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (μ : ι → Measure Ω) (X : Ω → ℝ)
    (hX : ∀ i, MemLp X 2 (μ i)) : MemLp X 2 (finiteMixture w μ) := by
  have hs : AEStronglyMeasurable X (finiteMixture w μ) := by
    rw [finiteMixture, ← Measure.sum_fintype]
    exact AEStronglyMeasurable.sum_measure
      (fun i => ((hX i).smul_measure ENNReal.coe_ne_top).aestronglyMeasurable)
  apply (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq hs).mpr
  rw [finiteMixture, integrable_finsetSum_measure]
  intro i _
  exact ((hX i).smul_measure ENNReal.coe_ne_top).integrable_sq

theorem actual_finite_mixture_mean
    (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (μ : ι → Measure Ω) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)]
    (X : Ω → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp X 2 (μ i)) :
    (∫ ω, X ω ∂finiteMixture w μ) =
      ∑ i, (w i : ℝ) * ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ i :=
  actual_finite_mixture_integral w μ X (fun i => (hX i).integrable one_le_two)

theorem actual_finite_mixture_variance
    (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (hw : ∑ i, w i = 1)
    (μ : ι → Measure Ω) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)]
    (X : Ω → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp X 2 (μ i)) :
    variance X (finiteMixture w μ) =
      (∑ i, (w i : ℝ) * variance X (μ i)) +
      ∑ i, (w i : ℝ) *
        ((∫ ω, X ω ∂μ i) - ∑ j, (w j : ℝ) * ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ j)^2 := by
  haveI := actual_finite_mixture_is_a_probability_law w hw μ
  have hr : ∑ i, (w i : ℝ) = 1 := by exact_mod_cast hw
  let m : ι → ℝ := fun i => ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ i
  let M : ℝ := ∑ i, (w i : ℝ) * m i
  have he : (∑ i, (w i : ℝ) * (m i - M)^2) =
      (∑ i, (w i : ℝ) * (m i)^2) - M^2 := by
    have hexp (i : ι) : (w i : ℝ) * (m i - M)^2 =
        (w i : ℝ) * (m i)^2 - (2*M)*((w i : ℝ)*m i) +
          M^2 * (w i : ℝ) := by ring
    simp_rw [hexp]
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
      ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.mul_sum, hr]
    change (∑ i, (w i : ℝ) * (m i)^2) - (2*M)*M + M^2*1 = _
    ring
  rw [variance_eq_sub (actual_finite_mixture_has_finite_second_moment w μ X hX),
    actual_finite_mixture_mean w μ X hX]
  have hsq := actual_finite_mixture_integral w μ (fun ω => (X ω)^2)
    (fun i => (hX i).integrable_sq)
  simp only [Pi.pow_apply] at hsq ⊢
  rw [hsq]
  have hv (i : ι) : variance X (μ i) = (∫ ω, (X ω)^2 ∂μ i) - (m i)^2 :=
    variance_eq_sub (hX i)
  simp_rw [hv, mul_sub]
  rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  change (∑ i, (w i : ℝ) * ∫ ω, (X ω)^2 ∂μ i) - M^2 =
      ((∑ i, (w i : ℝ) * ∫ ω, (X ω)^2 ∂μ i) -
        ∑ i, (w i : ℝ) * (m i)^2) + ∑ i, (w i : ℝ) * (m i - M)^2
  rw [he]
  ring

theorem actual_finite_mixture_of_densities_has_the_printed_density
    (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (base : Measure Ω) (p : ι → Ω → ℝ≥0∞)
    (hp : ∀ i, Measurable (p i)) :
    finiteMixture w (fun i => base.withDensity (p i)) =
      base.withDensity (fun ω => ∑ i, (w i : ℝ≥0∞) * p i ω) := by
  rw [finiteMixture, ← Measure.sum_fintype]
  have he (i : ι) : (w i : ℝ≥0∞) • base.withDensity (p i) =
      base.withDensity ((w i : ℝ≥0∞) • p i) :=
    (withDensity_smul (w i : ℝ≥0∞) (hp i)).symm
  simp_rw [he]
  change (Measure.sum (fun i => base.withDensity (fun ω => (w i : ℝ≥0∞) * p i ω))) = _
  rw [← withDensity_tsum (μ := base)
    (f := fun i ω => (w i : ℝ≥0∞) * p i ω)
    (fun i => measurable_const.mul (hp i))]
  congr 1
  ext ω
  simp [tsum_fintype, smul_eq_mul]

variable [MeasurableSpace ι] [MeasurableSingletonClass ι]

def twoStageLaw (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (μ : ι → Measure Ω) : Measure (ι × Ω) :=
  finiteMixture w (fun i => (Measure.dirac i).prod (μ i))

omit [MeasurableSingletonClass ι] in
theorem actual_two_stage_joint_is_a_probability_law
    (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (hw : ∑ i, w i = 1)
    (μ : ι → Measure Ω) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)] :
    IsProbabilityMeasure (twoStageLaw w μ) :=
  actual_finite_mixture_is_a_probability_law w hw _

theorem actual_two_stage_label_and_component_rectangle
    (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (μ : ι → Measure Ω) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)]
    (j : ι) (s : Set Ω) (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    twoStageLaw w μ ({j} ×ˢ s) = (w j : ℝ≥0∞) * μ j s := by
  classical
  simp only [twoStageLaw, finiteMixture, Measure.finsetSum_apply, Measure.smul_apply,
    smul_eq_mul, Measure.prod_prod, Measure.dirac_apply, Set.indicator_singleton, Pi.one_apply]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j]
  · simp
  · intro b _ hb
    simp [Pi.single_apply, hb, Ne.symm hb]
  · simp

omit [MeasurableSingletonClass ι] in
theorem actual_two_stage_second_marginal_is_the_finite_mixture
    (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (μ : ι → Measure Ω) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)] :
    (twoStageLaw w μ).snd = finiteMixture w μ := by
  ext s hs
  rw [Measure.snd_apply hs]
  have hpre : Prod.snd ⁻¹' s = (Set.univ : Set ι) ×ˢ s := by
    ext p
    simp
  rw [hpre]
  simp [twoStageLaw, finiteMixture, Measure.finsetSum_apply, Measure.smul_apply,
    Measure.prod_prod]

def countableMixture (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (μ : ι → Measure Ω) : Measure Ω :=
  Measure.sum (fun i => (w i : ℝ≥0∞) • μ i)

theorem actual_countable_mixture_is_a_probability_law
    (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (hw : ∑' i, (w i : ℝ≥0∞) = 1)
    (μ : ι → Measure Ω) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)] :
    IsProbabilityMeasure (countableMixture w μ) := by
  constructor
  simp only [countableMixture, Measure.sum_apply_of_countable, Measure.smul_apply,
    measure_univ, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  exact hw

theorem actual_countable_mixture_integral_hasSum
    (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (μ : ι → Measure Ω) (X : Ω → ℝ)
    (hX : Integrable X (countableMixture w μ)) :
    HasSum (fun i => (w i : ℝ) * ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ i)
      (∫ ω, X ω ∂countableMixture w μ) := by
  simpa only [countableMixture, integral_smul_measure, ENNReal.coe_toReal,
    smul_eq_mul] using hasSum_integral_measure hX

theorem actual_countable_mixture_mean
    (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (hw : ∑' i, (w i : ℝ≥0∞) = 1)
    (μ : ι → Measure Ω) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)]
    (X : Ω → ℝ) (hX : MemLp X 2 (countableMixture w μ)) :
    (∫ ω, X ω ∂countableMixture w μ) =
      ∑' i, (w i : ℝ) * ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ i := by
  haveI := actual_countable_mixture_is_a_probability_law w hw μ
  exact (actual_countable_mixture_integral_hasSum w μ X
    (hX.integrable one_le_two)).tsum_eq.symm

private theorem component_centered_second_moment
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (X : Ω → ℝ) (hX : MemLp X 2 μ) (M : ℝ) :
    (∫ ω, (X ω - M)^2 ∂μ) = variance X μ + ((∫ ω, X ω ∂μ) - M)^2 := by
  have hx := hX.integrable one_le_two
  have hp : (fun ω => (X ω - M)^2) =
      (fun ω => (X ω)^2 - (2*M)*X ω + M^2) := by ext ω; ring
  rw [hp]
  change (∫ ω, ((fun ω => (X ω)^2) - (fun ω => (2*M)*X ω)) ω + M^2 ∂μ) = _
  rw [integral_add (hX.integrable_sq.sub (hx.const_mul (2*M)))
    (integrable_const _)]
  simp only [Pi.sub_apply]
  rw [integral_sub hX.integrable_sq (hx.const_mul (2*M)),
    integral_const_mul, integral_const, variance_eq_sub hX]
  simp only [measureReal_def, measure_univ, ENNReal.toReal_one, one_smul, Pi.pow_apply]
  ring

theorem actual_countable_mixture_variance_and_series_summability
    (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (hw : ∑' i, (w i : ℝ≥0∞) = 1)
    (μ : ι → Measure Ω) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)]
    (X : Ω → ℝ) (hX : MemLp X 2 (countableMixture w μ))
    (hXi : ∀ i, MemLp X 2 (μ i)) :
    Summable (fun i => (w i : ℝ) * variance X (μ i)) ∧
    Summable (fun i => (w i : ℝ) *
      ((∫ ω, X ω ∂μ i) - ∑' j, (w j : ℝ) * ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ j)^2) ∧
    variance X (countableMixture w μ) =
      (∑' i, (w i : ℝ) * variance X (μ i)) +
      ∑' i, (w i : ℝ) *
        ((∫ ω, X ω ∂μ i) - ∑' j, (w j : ℝ) * ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ j)^2 := by
  haveI := actual_countable_mixture_is_a_probability_law w hw μ
  let M : ℝ := ∫ ω, X ω ∂countableMixture w μ
  let a : ι → ℝ := fun i => (w i : ℝ) * variance X (μ i)
  let b : ι → ℝ := fun i => (w i : ℝ) * ((∫ ω, X ω ∂μ i) - M)^2
  have hs := actual_countable_mixture_integral_hasSum w μ (fun ω => (X ω - M)^2)
    (hX.sub (memLp_const M)).integrable_sq
  have he (i : ι) : (w i : ℝ) * (∫ ω, (X ω - M)^2 ∂μ i) = a i + b i := by
    rw [component_centered_second_moment (μ i) X (hXi i) M]
    simp only [a, b, mul_add]
  simp_rw [he] at hs
  have ha0 (i : ι) : 0 ≤ a i := mul_nonneg (NNReal.coe_nonneg _) (variance_nonneg _ _)
  have hb0 (i : ι) : 0 ≤ b i := mul_nonneg (NNReal.coe_nonneg _) (sq_nonneg _)
  have has : Summable a := Summable.of_nonneg_of_le ha0
    (fun i => le_add_of_nonneg_right (hb0 i)) hs.summable
  have hbs : Summable b := Summable.of_nonneg_of_le hb0
    (fun i => le_add_of_nonneg_left (ha0 i)) hs.summable
  have hm := actual_countable_mixture_mean w hw μ X hX
  have hvar : variance X (countableMixture w μ) = (∑' i, a i) + ∑' i, b i := by
    rw [variance_eq_integral hX.aemeasurable, ← hs.tsum_eq]
    exact has.tsum_add hbs
  simpa only [a, b, M, hm] using And.intro has (And.intro hbs hvar)

theorem actual_countable_mixture_of_densities_has_the_printed_density
    (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (base : Measure Ω) (p : ι → Ω → ℝ≥0∞)
    (hp : ∀ i, Measurable (p i)) :
    countableMixture w (fun i => base.withDensity (p i)) =
      base.withDensity (fun ω => ∑' i, (w i : ℝ≥0∞) * p i ω) := by
  have he (i : ι) : (w i : ℝ≥0∞) • base.withDensity (p i) =

  change (Measure.sum (fun i => base.withDensity (fun ω => (w i : ℝ≥0∞) * p i ω))) = _
  rw [← withDensity_tsum (μ := base)

  congr 1
  ext ω
  exact ENNReal.tsum_apply

def twoStageLaw (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (μ : ι → Measure Ω) : Measure (ι × Ω) :=

    (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (μ : ι → Measure Ω) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)]
    (j : ι) (s : Set Ω) :
    twoStageLaw w μ ({j} ×ˢ s) = (w j : ℝ≥0∞) * μ j s := by

  apply (prod_prod_le s t).antisymm
  -- Formalization is based on https://mathoverflow.net/a/254134/136589
  set ST := toMeasurable (μ.prod ν) (s ×ˢ t)
  have hSTm : MeasurableSet ST := measurableSet_toMeasurable _ _
  have hST : s ×ˢ t ⊆ ST := subset_toMeasurable _ _
  set f : α → ℝ≥0∞ := fun x => ν (Prod.mk x ⁻¹' ST)
  have hfm : Measurable f := measurable_measure_prodMk_left hSTm
  set s' : Set α := { x | ν t ≤ f x }

    _ = ∫⁻ _ in s', ν t ∂μ := by rw [setLIntegral_const, mul_comm]
    _ ≤ ∫⁻ x in s', f x ∂μ := setLIntegral_mono hfm fun x => id
    _ ≤ ∫⁻ x, f x ∂μ := lintegral_mono' restrict_le_self le_rfl
    _ = μ.prod ν ST := (prod_apply hSTm).symm

Definition — Variance, covariance, covariance matrix
Assume finite second moments for the variance and covariance formulas below. $\operatorname{Var}(X)=\mathbb E[(X-\mathbb EX)^2]=\mathbb E[X^2]-(\mathbb EX)^2$; the standard deviation $\sqrt{\operatorname{Var}X}$ has the units of $X$ (noise variance $0.01$ means standard deviation $0.1$), and $\operatorname{Var}(aX+b)=a^2\operatorname{Var}X$. $\operatorname{Cov}(X,Y)=\mathbb E[(X-\mathbb EX)(Y-\mathbb EY)]$. For a random vector $X\in\mathbb R^n$ with mean $m$,
$$\Sigma=\operatorname{Cov}(X)=\mathbb E\big[(X-m)(X-m)^\top\big],\qquad \Sigma_{ij}=\operatorname{Cov}(X_i,X_j),\qquad \operatorname{Cov}(AX+b)=A\Sigma A^\top .$$
Isotropic noise has $\Sigma=\sigma^2I$: uncorrelated coordinates with the same variance $\sigma^2$ in every direction. The correlation of $X,Y$ with standard deviations $\sigma_X,\sigma_Y\gt0$ is $\rho=\operatorname{Cov}(X,Y)/(\sigma_X\sigma_Y)$, the covariance of the standardised variables. It lies in $[-1,1]$ because $0\le\operatorname{Var}\big(\tfrac X{\sigma_X}\pm\tfrac Y{\sigma_Y}\big)=2(1\pm\rho)$, and $\rho=\pm1$ exactly when $Y$ is almost surely an affine function of $X$ (slope of sign $\pm$). In these terms the vector $(X,Y)$ has covariance matrix $\begin{bmatrix}\sigma_X^2&\rho\sigma_X\sigma_Y\\\rho\sigma_X\sigma_Y&\sigma_Y^2\end{bmatrix}$.
Fact — Covariance matrices are positive semidefinite
For every $v\in\mathbb R^n$, $v^\top\Sigma v=\mathbb E\big[(v^\top(X-m))^2\big]=\operatorname{Var}(v^\top X)\ge0$, so $\Sigma\succeq0$ (Primer A). It is positive definite, hence invertible, iff no nonzero combination $v^\top X$ is almost surely constant.

Worked example (ensemble spread). Two ensemble members predict means $\mu_1=(1,0)$ and $\mu_2=(-1,0)$. Their average is $\bar\mu=(0,0)$ and the outer-product estimate $\hat\Sigma=\tfrac12\sum_e(\mu_e-\bar\mu)(\mu_e-\bar\mu)^\top=\begin{bmatrix}1&0\\0&0\end{bmatrix}$ is PSD but singular: the members disagree only along the first axis. With $E$ members in $\mathbb R^n$ this estimate has rank at most $E-1$, so it is singular whenever $E\le n$ and must not be inverted. A fusion rule such as $\big(\tfrac1E\sum_e\Sigma_e^{-1}\big)^{-1}$ needs every member covariance $\Sigma_e$ to be positive definite.

Worked example (averaging over a policy). In a state $s$, action $a_1$ has expected cost $\mathbb E[X\mid a_1]=2$ and action $a_2$ has $\mathbb E[X\mid a_2]=10$. Under $\pi=(0.7,0.3)$ the tower rule gives $\mathbb E[X]=0.7\cdot2+0.3\cdot10=4.4$. Under another policy $\pi'=(0.9,0.1)$ the conditional expectations, a property of the environment, are unchanged and only the weights move: $0.9\cdot2+0.1\cdot10=2.8$. The performance-difference lemma averages the advantage of $\pi$ over the actions of $\pi'$ in exactly this way.

Theorem — Law of total variance
$\operatorname{Var}(X)=\mathbb E\big[\operatorname{Var}(X\mid Y)\big]+\operatorname{Var}\big(\mathbb E[X\mid Y]\big)$: the average spread within groups plus the spread of the group means. Proof. With $\bar X=\mathbb E[X\mid Y]$, the tower rule gives $\mathbb E[X^2]=\mathbb E\big[\mathbb E[X^2\mid Y]\big]=\mathbb E\big[\operatorname{Var}(X\mid Y)+\bar X^2\big]$ and $\mathbb E[X]=\mathbb E[\bar X]$; subtract $(\mathbb E\bar X)^2$ from both sides. $\square$ For vectors, $\operatorname{Cov}(X)=\mathbb E[\operatorname{Cov}(X\mid Y)]+\operatorname{Cov}(\mathbb E[X\mid Y])$.
Definition — Mixture distribution
First draw a label $L$ with $\mathbb P(L=j)=w_j$, then draw $X$ from the component law $p_j$ (mean $m_j$, variance $\sigma_j^2$). Then $X$ has density $p(x)=\sum_jw_jp_j(x)$, mean $\bar m=\sum_jw_jm_j$ and, by total variance, $\operatorname{Var}X=\sum_jw_j\sigma_j^2+\sum_jw_j(m_j-\bar m)^2$.

Worked example (small and large errors). Residuals that are $\mathcal N(0,0.5^2)$ with probability $0.8$ and $\mathcal N(0,3^2)$ with probability $0.2$ (the "80% small, 20% large" option of the Module 15 explorer) have variance $0.8\cdot0.25+0.2\cdot9=2$. Their tail is nothing like that of $\mathcal N(0,2)$: $\mathbb P(|E|\gt5)=0.8\cdot\mathbb P(|Z|\gt10)+0.2\cdot\mathbb P(|Z|\gt\tfrac53)\approx0.019$, against $0.0004$ for the Gaussian with the same variance, while near zero the mixture is more concentrated ($\mathbb P(|E|\gt1)\approx0.18$ against $0.48$). An ensemble of $E$ Gaussian predictions is an equal-weight mixture: its covariance is the average member covariance (aleatoric part) plus the covariance of the member means (epistemic part, the $\hat\Sigma$ of Section 1).

namespace SafeLearning.CompleteAppliedMixtureCovarianceMaterial24
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open scoped ENNReal NNReal BigOperators Matrix.Norms.Elementwise
variable {ι Ω : Type*} [Fintype ι] [MeasurableSpace Ω]
def finiteMixture (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (μ : ι → Measure Ω) : Measure Ω :=
  ∑ i, (w i : ℝ≥0∞) • μ i
private theorem probability_law (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (hw : ∑ i, w i = 1)
    (μ : ι → Measure Ω) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)] :
    IsProbabilityMeasure (finiteMixture w μ) := by
  constructor
  simp only [finiteMixture, Measure.finsetSum_apply, Measure.smul_apply,
    measure_univ, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  exact_mod_cast hw
private theorem weighted_integral (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (μ : ι → Measure Ω)
    (X : Ω → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, Integrable X (μ i)) :
    (∫ ω, X ω ∂finiteMixture w μ) = ∑ i, (w i : ℝ) * ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ i := by
  rw [finiteMixture, integral_finsetSum_measure
    (fun i _ => (hX i).smul_measure ENNReal.coe_ne_top)]
  simp [NNReal.smul_def, smul_eq_mul]
private theorem mixture_memLp (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (μ : ι → Measure Ω)
    (X : Ω → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp X 2 (μ i)) : MemLp X 2 (finiteMixture w μ) := by
  have hs : AEStronglyMeasurable X (finiteMixture w μ) := by
    rw [finiteMixture, ← Measure.sum_fintype]
    exact AEStronglyMeasurable.sum_measure
      (fun i => ((hX i).smul_measure ENNReal.coe_ne_top).aestronglyMeasurable)
  apply (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq hs).mpr
  rw [finiteMixture, integrable_finsetSum_measure]
  intro i _
  exact ((hX i).smul_measure ENNReal.coe_ne_top).integrable_sq
private theorem component_centered_product (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (X Y : Ω → ℝ) (hX : MemLp X 2 μ) (hY : MemLp Y 2 μ) (M N : ℝ) :
    (∫ ω, (X ω - M)*(Y ω - N) ∂μ) =
      covariance X Y μ + ((∫ ω, X ω ∂μ)-M)*((∫ ω, Y ω ∂μ)-N) := by
  have hx := hX.integrable one_le_two
  have hy := hY.integrable one_le_two
  have hxy := hX.integrable_mul hY
  have he : (fun ω => (X ω-M)*(Y ω-N)) =
      (fun ω => X ω*Y ω-N*X ω-M*Y ω+M*N) := by ext ω; ring
  rw [he]
  change (∫ ω, (((X*Y)-(fun ω=>N*X ω))-(fun ω=>M*Y ω)) ω + M*N ∂μ) = _
  rw [integral_add ((hxy.sub (hx.const_mul N)).sub (hy.const_mul M))
    (integrable_const _)]
  rw [integral_sub' (hxy.sub (hx.const_mul N)) (hy.const_mul M),
    integral_sub' hxy (hx.const_mul N)]
  simp only [Pi.mul_apply]
  rw [integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul,
    integral_const, covariance_eq_sub hX hY]
  simp only [probReal_univ, one_smul, Pi.mul_apply]
  ring

theorem actual_finite_mixture_covariance_within_and_between
    (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (hw : ∑ i, w i = 1)
    (μ : ι → Measure Ω) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)]
    (X Y : Ω → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp X 2 (μ i)) (hY : ∀ i, MemLp Y 2 (μ i)) :
    covariance X Y (finiteMixture w μ) =
      (∑ i, (w i : ℝ)*covariance X Y (μ i)) +
      ∑ i, (w i : ℝ)*
        ((∫ ω, X ω ∂μ i)-(∑ j, (w j : ℝ)*∫ ω, X ω ∂μ j))*
        ((∫ ω, Y ω ∂μ i)-(∑ j, (w j : ℝ)*∫ ω, Y ω ∂μ j)) := by
  let M : ℝ := ∑ j, (w j : ℝ)*∫ ω, X ω ∂μ j
  let N : ℝ := ∑ j, (w j : ℝ)*∫ ω, Y ω ∂μ j
  have hx := weighted_integral w μ X (fun i => (hX i).integrable one_le_two)
  have hy := weighted_integral w μ Y (fun i => (hY i).integrable one_le_two)
  rw [covariance, hx, hy]
  rw [weighted_integral w μ (fun ω => (X ω-M)*(Y ω-N))
    (fun i => (hX i |>.sub (memLp_const M)).integrable_mul (hY i |>.sub (memLp_const N)))]
  simp_rw [component_centered_product _ _ _ (hX _) (hY _), mul_add]
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  simp only [M, N, mul_assoc]

variable [MeasurableSpace ι] [MeasurableSingletonClass ι]
def labelLaw (w : ι → ℝ≥0) : Measure ι := finiteMixture w (fun i => Measure.dirac i)

theorem actual_covariance_of_component_means_is_the_between_term
    (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (m n : ι → ℝ) :
    covariance m n (labelLaw w) =
      ∑ i, (w i : ℝ)* (m i-∑ j, (w j : ℝ)*m j)*
        (n i-∑ j, (w j : ℝ)*n j) := by
  have hi (f : ι → ℝ) : (∫ i, f i ∂labelLaw w) = ∑ i, (w i : ℝ)*f i := by
    rw [labelLaw, weighted_integral w (fun i => Measure.dirac i) f
      (fun i => integrable_dirac (by simp))]
    simp
  rw [covariance, hi m, hi n, hi]
  simp only [mul_assoc]

def covarianceMatrix {κ : Type*} (X : κ → Ω → ℝ) (μ : Measure Ω) : Matrix κ κ ℝ :=
  fun a b => covariance (X a) (X b) μ

theorem actual_finite_vector_mixture_covariance_matrix
    {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ] (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (hw : ∑ i, w i = 1)
    (μ : ι → Measure Ω) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)]
    (X : κ → Ω → ℝ) (hX : ∀ a i, MemLp (X a) 2 (μ i)) :
    covarianceMatrix X (finiteMixture w μ) =
      (∑ i, (w i : ℝ) • covarianceMatrix X (μ i)) +
      covarianceMatrix (fun a i => ∫ ω, X a ω ∂μ i) (labelLaw w) := by
  ext a b
  simp only [Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, covarianceMatrix]
  rw [actual_finite_mixture_covariance_within_and_between w hw μ
    (X a) (X b) (hX a) (hX b), actual_covariance_of_component_means_is_the_between_term]
  simp only [smul_eq_mul]

theorem actual_equal_weight_ensemble_covariance_matrix
    {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ] [Nonempty ι]
    (μ : ι → Measure Ω) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)]
    (X : κ → Ω → ℝ) (hX : ∀ a i, MemLp (X a) 2 (μ i)) :
    covarianceMatrix X
      (finiteMixture (fun _ => (Fintype.card ι : ℝ≥0)⁻¹) μ) =
      (1/(Fintype.card ι : ℝ)) • (∑ i, covarianceMatrix X (μ i)) +
      covarianceMatrix (fun a i => ∫ ω, X a ω ∂μ i)
        (labelLaw (fun _ => (Fintype.card ι : ℝ≥0)⁻¹)) := by
  have hc : (Fintype.card ι : ℝ≥0) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero
  have hw : (∑ i : ι, (Fintype.card ι : ℝ≥0)⁻¹) = 1 := by
    simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul]
    exact mul_inv_cancel₀ hc
  rw [actual_finite_vector_mixture_covariance_matrix _ hw μ X hX]
  simp only [NNReal.coe_inv, NNReal.coe_natCast, ← Finset.smul_sum, one_div]

    (∫ ω, (μ[X ^ 2 | m]) ω ∂μ) = ∫ ω, (X ω) ^ 2 ∂μ := by
  exact ⟨integral_condExp hm, integral_condExp hm⟩

theorem actual_conditional_second_moment_is_variance_plus_squared_mean
    (hm : m ≤ m₀) (X : Ω → ℝ) (hX : MemLp X 2 μ) :

  filter_upwards [condVar_ae_eq_condExp_sq_sub_sq_condExp hm hX] with ω h
  dsimp at h ⊢

  have hxm : MemLp (μ[X | m]) 2 μ := hX.condExp one_le_two
  have hym : MemLp (μ[Y | m]) 2 μ := hY.condExp one_le_two

      ∑ i, (w i : ℝ)* (m i-∑ j, (w j : ℝ)*m j)*
        (n i-∑ j, (w j : ℝ)*n j) := by
  have hi (f : ι → ℝ) : (∫ i, f i ∂labelLaw w) = ∑ i, (w i : ℝ)*f i := by
    rw [labelLaw, weighted_integral w (fun i => Measure.dirac i) f
      (fun i => integrable_dirac (by simp))]
    simp
  rw [covariance, hi m, hi n, hi]
  simp only [mul_assoc]

def covarianceMatrix {κ : Type*} (X : κ → Ω → ℝ) (μ : Measure Ω) : Matrix κ κ ℝ :=
  fun a b => covariance (X a) (X b) μ

theorem actual_finite_vector_mixture_covariance_matrix
    {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ] (w : ι → ℝ≥0) (hw : ∑ i, w i = 1)
    (μ : ι → Measure Ω) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)]
    (X : κ → Ω → ℝ) (hX : ∀ a i, MemLp (X a) 2 (μ i)) :
    covarianceMatrix X (finiteMixture w μ) =
      (∑ i, (w i : ℝ) • covarianceMatrix X (μ i)) +
      covarianceMatrix (fun a i => ∫ ω, X a ω ∂μ i) (labelLaw w) := by
  ext a b
  simp only [Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, covarianceMatrix]
  rw [actual_finite_mixture_covariance_within_and_between w hw μ
    (X a) (X b) (hX a) (hX b), actual_covariance_of_component_means_is_the_between_term]
  simp only [smul_eq_mul]

theorem actual_equal_weight_ensemble_covariance_matrix
    {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ] [Nonempty ι]
    (μ : ι → Measure Ω) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)]
    (X : κ → Ω → ℝ) (hX : ∀ a i, MemLp (X a) 2 (μ i)) :
    covarianceMatrix X
      (finiteMixture (fun _ => (Fintype.card ι : ℝ≥0)⁻¹) μ) =
      (1/(Fintype.card ι : ℝ)) • (∑ i, covarianceMatrix X (μ i)) +
      covarianceMatrix (fun a i => ∫ ω, X a ω ∂μ i)
        (labelLaw (fun _ => (Fintype.card ι : ℝ≥0)⁻¹)) := by
  have hc : (Fintype.card ι : ℝ≥0) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero
  have hw : (∑ i : ι, (Fintype.card ι : ℝ≥0)⁻¹) = 1 := by
    simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul]
    exact mul_inv_cancel₀ hc
  rw [actual_finite_vector_mixture_covariance_matrix _ hw μ X hX]
  simp only [NNReal.coe_inv, NNReal.coe_natCast, ← Finset.smul_sum, one_div]
